text: 1. Valid ordinary passport. If the applicant is in China, a valid residence permit also needs to be submitted.2. Highest academic degree certificate (Fresh graduates should provide a pre-graduation certificate and bring a paper graduation certificate when reporting to China in September);3. Academic transcript4. "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners"Applicants should strictly follow the items required in the "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners" for the examination and fill it out in either Chinese or English. The "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners" is invalid if it is missing pages, does not have the individual's photo attached, does not have a cross-stamp on the photo, or does not have the hospital's seal or the doctor's signature. Given that the validity period of the inspection results is six months. Applicants are requested to determine the time for their physical examination accordingly.5. A valid certificate of no criminal record. If the applicant is already in China, only a performance certificate or a certificate of no disciplinary violations issued by the current institution is required.6. Proof of language proficiency;7. Study plan (undergraduate) or research plan (master's and doctoral);8. Two recommendation letters signed by (associate) professors (undergraduate students exempted);9. Acceptance letter from the supervisor (not mandatory, but the submitter will be given priority for admission);10. Can be submitted: academic achievements [very important], certificates of awards from various cultural and sports activities.
